title: The Piecewise Polynomial Least Squares Method: Comprehensive Analysis and Application to a Fractional-Order Prey-Predator Model
content: The Piecewise Polynomial Least Squares Method is a straightforward method to compute accurate approximate analytical solutions for a very wide range of differential problems. The paper presents an extensive study of the method including results regarding the existence and global convergence for the solution and a result regarding the estimation of the error. As an application a fractional-order prey-predator (Lotka-Volterra) model is discussed.
